manualReport.title: Match result

state.nothing: No result reported yet. Whoever played it, report the score.
state.needsAnswer: {{team}} reported this result. Confirm it if it is right.
state.disputed: This result is disputed. An admin will decide it.
state.awaitingAdmin: Waiting for an admin to decide this match.
state.confirmed: Both teams agree on this result.

deadline.autoConfirm: Confirms on its own in {{minutes}} min if nobody answers.
deadline.autoConfirmSoon: Confirms on its own any moment now.
deadline.escalate: Goes to an admin in {{minutes}} min if nobody answers.
deadline.escalateSoon: Goes to an admin any moment now.

errors.incomplete: Fill in both scores for at least one game.
errors.failed: That did not go through. Try again.

captains.hint: Only a captain can report or confirm a result for this team.
captains.empty: Nobody on this team has signed in yet, so there is nobody to appoint.
captains.failed: Could not change that. Try again.

stats.hint: The extra numbers this tournament asks for. Leave a field blank if nobody has one.
